To: Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]>, Mark Hannafin <[contact omitted]>, Claire Russo <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]>, Neilesh Shelat <[contact omitted]>, Ciara Knudsen
<[contact omitted]>, Brittany Brown <[contact omitted]>, Rob Horvath <[contact omitted]>, Adam Kaplan
<[contact omitted]>, Nicole Patierno <[contact omitted]>, Ryan McCannell <[contact omitted]>, Nicole Weir
<[contact omitted]>, Marnie Valdivia <[contact omitted]>, Julie Werbel <[contact omitted]>
+Mark Hannafin +Claire Russo
Vera,
Adding to the welcome - we are very excited that you're on board!
Since the next CPS digital huddle is a ways off, it would be great for CPS technical/policy folks and interested bureau
leadership to meet with you beforehand. We would love to hear about your plans for the portfolio and give you an
overview of CPS' work in these arenas. If that sounds good, we can find a time in the next couple of weeks.
Best,
Leah
On Wed, May 11, 2022 at 4:24 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Amy,
Wonderful. And delighted to meet you all, partner, and work with you. Would welcome an opportunity to connect on all
of these issues.
Warmly, Vera
On Wed, May 11, 2022 at 12:54 PM Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Welcome Vera! We look forward to working with you. We have a monthly "CPS Digital Huddle" if you'd like to drop in
and say hi. (: I can add you to the next invite.
Amy Noreuil Malessa
Senior Digital Technology Advisor for Field Programs Division
Bureau for Conflict Prevention and Stabilization | Office of Transition Initiatives | Creative Digital Team
US Agency for International Development
[opaque block]
On Wed, May 11, 2022 at 3:42 PM Julie Werbel <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear CPS colleagues,
With this email, I would like to introduce you to Vera Zakem who recently joined DDI/DRG where she will lead a
portfolio focused on technology and democracy, including mis- dis-and malinformation (MDM). She's interested in
connecting with CPS Bureau leadership and experts tracking this space.
You can find her pre-USAID bio here. Please look out for further correspondence from her or feel free to reach out
directly.
Best,
Julie
Julie Werbel

Center for Conflict and Violence Prevention (CVP)
